philosophy: We sell hope. High FOMO for locked content, professional scouting credibility. Mobile-first (390px baseline) with zero pinch/zoom. Kill the meta-noise.

visual_hierarchy.level_1_the_verdict: Hero Section: Player photo, massive Overall Score (8.0), Potential Assessment, and ONE unified trust badge.
visual_hierarchy.level_2_the_evidence: Top Strengths & Moments. These are the trust anchors. Big photo frames, exact timestamp, and 'See the Proof' video buttons.
visual_hierarchy.level_3_the_deep_dive: Data & Ratings. 25 skill ratings categorized into 4 groups. Collapsed by default using accordions to reduce visual noise.
visual_hierarchy.level_4_the_journey: Roadmap, Weekly Plan, Parents Package. Supportive content grouped at the bottom, accessible via tabs or expand/collapse.

design_patterns.kill_meta_noise: Consolidate all individual badges ('verified', 'tier', 'confidence', 'tracked') into ONE global 'Scout Certified Analysis' lockup in the header. Remove repeating metadata from every stat row. If metadata is necessary, hide it inside an info tooltip.

card_variants.hero_card: Full bleed on mobile, dark background, large typography, lime accent.
card_variants.standard_card: Cream background (#F6F3EA), crisp corners (rounded-md), very dark text. Used for readable content like Parents Package, Roadmap.
card_variants.quiet_card: Dark surface (#15201A) with subtle 1px border. Used for stats and secondary data.

design_patterns.the_moment_object: The core interactive object. Aspect ratio 16:9 or 4:3 photo frame. Overlaid with a dark gradient at the bottom. Contains: large Lime 'Play' icon, exact timestamp (e.g., '14:23'), and 'See the Proof' text.
design_patterns.progressive_disclosure: The Premium report is ~17,000px tall. Use Accordions for the '25 skill ratings' (group by 4 categories). Use horizontal scroll (carousels) for the 4 top strengths instead of stacking them vertically.
design_patterns.locked_fomo_treatment: On the Free Page: Show the silhouette or heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) over locked content. Place a solid black overlay with 50% opacity, and a massive, glowing Lime padlock. Add a high-contrast 'What you are missing' list.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons lift (-translate-y-1) and cast a subtle lime glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)]).
motion_and_interactions.accordions: Smooth height transition using framer-motion or CSS grid (grid-template-rows: 0fr -> 1fr).
motion_and_interactions.video_play: Tap on a 'Moment' ripples and opens a full-screen video modal.

accessibility.contrast: Do not place Lime text on Cream cards (fails APCA). Use Dark Green buttons with Lime text on Cream cards, or use Lime buttons with Dark Green text.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactable elements on mobile.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='unlock-premium-button').

hero_player.description: Young male soccer player portrait - Use for the hero section.

moments_action.description: Action shot - Use for 'Top Strengths' and 'Moments' cards.

stadium_backgrounds.description: Stadium lights - Use for dark backgrounds or header overlays with low opacity.

instructions_to_main_agent: This app uses standard React (.js files, NOT .tsx). Do not write TypeScript.
Implement a mobile-first (390px) layout. Do not build a desktop dashboard. Scale it up for desktop by restricting max-width to 'max-w-md mx-auto' or using a split-pane layout.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for sticky headers. Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#0D1512]/80.
Use Shadcn UI Accordion components to compress the 25 skill ratings into 4 expandable categories.
Implement the 'Moment' object exactly as specified: photo frame, exact timestamp overlay, and 'See the Proof' button.
Kill the meta-noise. Do not render 15 different badges for 'tracked', 'confidence', etc. Replace with a single 'Scout Certified' lockup at the top of the report.
On the Free page, use 'blur-md' and lock icons to drive FOMO. Include a high-contrast pricing/upgrade strip.
Ensure the Volt/Lime (#CCFF00) color is used strictly for CTAs and highlighted metrics. Do not overuse it.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined Archetype and color specificities.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
